379 source-snapshot files and 40 program files were read back from the remote branch and matched. Existing OS paths/workflows remain unchanged; no deployment/backend changes. All 1,179 original archive hashes and recovery bundle matched. Fresh host reads matched 48 application-source files, preserving five older hosted control documents separately. Original Git history was not pushed: git transport had no push credentials, so the authorized connector created a labeled source snapshot. SOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json records omitted historical generated evidence and the visual-reference binary retained in the complete ZIP. Complete source/recovery and host-scaffold package is delivered separately to the owner; environment secrets, field data and signing materials are excluded.

Keep PR #96 a preservation/development review. Do not merge it as an OS runtime upgrade. Future OS cutover uses the current maintained editor and authorized adapter, preserving newer document work. Old unsigned Apple compilation is not current installed-device acceptance; all platform gaps are explicit in CURRENT_STATE and PLATFORM_DELIVERY.

Before F04, resolve whether cutouts also include recesses/boundary notches/floor-ceiling voids. Earlier features can proceed without that decision.
